a: A path with closed and open subpaths, a fill, and no stroke is written as a group holding an invisible extra `<path>`
`revert` and `revert-layer` on an inherited property are kept as a literal value, not rolled back
A nested `<svg width="auto">` leaves its children with no viewport for percentages
A `container` shorthand declared after `container-type` does not reset it
b: `svgNodesFromKit` with `roots` below the top drops the paint a root inherits, though it rebuilds the root's frame from its ancestors
A marker key can mint the same `<defs>` id as a gradient, pattern, clip or text cut
